    while c<w:
        if grid[r][c]==4:

            while c<w and grid[r][c]==4:c+=1
            en=c-1
            if st>0 and c<w and grid[r][st-1]==9 and grid[r][c]==9:
                marked.update((r,j) for j in range(st,c))
        else:c+=1
for c in range(w):
    r=0

        if grid[r][c]==4:
            st=r
            while r<h and grid[r][c]==4:r+=1
            en=r-1
            if st>0 and r<h and grid[st-1][c]==9 and grid[r][c]==9:
                marked.update((i,c) for i in range(st,r))
        else:r+=1
print(sorted(marked))
out=[[2 if (r,c) in marked else x for c,x in enumerate(row)] for r,row in enumerate(grid)]
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
